# Kenney assets (CC0)

From [KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-FPS](https://github.com/KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-FPS) at commit
`185fd2326d74a5cf858cffc616f87cf9696f9cc0`. Its README states that the sprites, 3D models and
sound effects are [CC0 licensed](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

| File here | Source | Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Models/cloud.fbx` | `models/cloud.glb` | converted to FBX with Blender |
| `Sprites/*.png` | `sprites/crosshair.png`, `burst.png`, `hit.png` | none |
| `Sounds/*.ogg` | `sounds/blaster.ogg`, `enemy_destroy.ogg`, `enemy_hurt.ogg` | none |
